name: RNG Fights
desc:
Fight to the death with randomly generated attacks! Roll over 35 unique abilities, ranging from a simple punch to controlling time itself. Upgrade your luck, start server events, and much more!

⚠️ Game contains flashing images which may be unsuitable for some players ⚠️


Credits: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/rng-fights-credits/3228151
v1.49.3

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local eventsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EventsFolder")
local generateAttackEvent = eventsFolder:WaitForChild("GenerateAttack")
local updateAttackEvent = eventsFolder:WaitForChild("UpdateAttack")

local currentAttackValue = 0

local updateConnection = updateAttackEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arg1, arg2, arg3)
    if type(arg2) == "number" then
        currentAttackValue = arg2
    elseif type(arg3) == "number" then
        currentAttackValue = arg3
    end
end)

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AdvancedMultiSectionGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 280)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local topBar = Instance.new("Frame")
topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
topBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topBar.Parent = mainFrame

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 13

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizeButton.Name = "MinimizeButton"
minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 5)
minimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
minimizeButton.Text = "-"
minimizeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minimizeButton.TextSize = 13
minimizeButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
minimizeButton.AutoButtonColor = false
minimizeButton.Parent = topBar

local minCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
minCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
minCorner.Parent = minimizeButton

local contentWrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
contentWrapper.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -32)
contentWrapper.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32)
contentWrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
contentWrapper.Parent = mainFrame

local categoryScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
categoryScroll.Name = "CategoryScroll"
categoryScroll.Size = UDim2.new(0, 105, 1, -10)
categoryScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
categoryScroll.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
categoryScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
categoryScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
categoryScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
categoryScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
categoryScroll.Parent = contentWrapper

local catScrollCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
catScrollCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local catLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
catLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
catLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
catLayout.Parent = categoryScroll

local catPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
catPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
catPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
catPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
catPad.Parent = categoryScroll

local toggleArea = Instance.new("Frame")
toggleArea.Name = "ToggleArea"
toggleArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, -10)
toggleArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 0, 5)
toggleArea.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
toggleArea.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleArea.Parent = contentWrapper

local toggleAreaCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleAreaCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleAreaCorner.Parent = toggleArea

local isMinimized = false
minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        minimizeButton.Text = "+"
        contentWrapper.Visible = false
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 32)
    else
        minimizeButton.Text = "-"
        contentWrapper.Visible = true
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 280)
    end
end)

local scriptRunning = true
local desyncTpwalking = false
local loopTpwalking = false

local function stopDesyncTPWalk()
    desyncTpwalking = false
end

local function stopLoopTPWalk()
    loopTpwalking = false
end

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    scriptRunning = false
    stopDesyncTPWalk()
    stopLoopTPWalk()
    if updateConnection then
        updateConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
    end
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)

local categories = {}
local activeCategoryName = nil

local function addCategory(name)
    local catButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    catButton.Name = name .. "Btn"
    catButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    catButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    catButton.Text = name
    catButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    catButton.TextSize = 11
    catButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    catButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    catButton.Parent = categoryScroll
    
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    btnCorner.Parent = catButton
    
    local togglesScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    togglesScroll.Name = name .. "ToggleScroll"
    togglesScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
    togglesScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
    togglesScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    togglesScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    togglesScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    togglesScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    togglesScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    togglesScroll.Visible = false
    togglesScroll.Parent = toggleArea
    
    local tLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    tLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    tLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    tLayout.Parent = togglesScroll
    
    local tPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    tPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.Parent = togglesScroll
    
    categories[name] = {
        Button = catButton,
        Container = togglesScroll
    }
    
    catButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for catName, data in pairs(categories) do
            data.Container.Visible = false
            data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
            data.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        end
        togglesScroll.Visible = true
        catButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        catButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        activeCategoryName = name
    end)
    
    if not activeCategoryName then
        togglesScroll.Visible = true
        catButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        catButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        activeCategoryName = name
    end
    
    return togglesScroll
end

local function createToggle(catScroll, name, labelText, callback)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name = name .. "Container"
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.Parent = catScroll
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelText
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container
    
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name .. "Button"
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 18)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -9)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    button.Text = ""
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.Parent = container
    
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    btnCorner.Parent = button
    
    local indicator = Instance.new("Frame")
    indicator.Name = "Indicator"
    indicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    indicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)
    indicator.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    indicator.Parent = button
    
    local indCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    indCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    indCorner.Parent = indicator
    
    local state = false
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        if state then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
            indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        else
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
            indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        end
        if callback then task.spawn(callback, state) end
    end)
    
    return {
        GetState = function() return state end,
        SetState = function(val)
            if state ~= val then
                state = val
                if state then
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
                    indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
                else
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
                    indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
                end
                if callback then task.spawn(callback, state) end
            end
        end
    }
end

local function createSlider(catScroll, name, labelText, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name = name .. "SliderContainer"
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.Parent = catScroll

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelText .. ": " .. tostring(defaultVal)
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container

    local foldBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    foldBtn.Name = "FoldButton"
    foldBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
    foldBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    foldBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 0)
    foldBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    foldBtn.Text = "-"
    foldBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    foldBtn.TextSize = 13
    foldBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    foldBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    foldBtn.Parent = container

    local foldCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    foldCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    foldCorner.Parent = foldBtn
    
    local sliderBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBar.Name = "SliderBar"
    sliderBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 6)
    sliderBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 26)
    sliderBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    sliderBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBar.Parent = container
    
    local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    barCorner.Parent = sliderBar
    
    local fillBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    fillBar.Name = "FillBar"
    fillBar.Size = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0)
    fillBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
    fillBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fillBar.Parent = sliderBar
    
    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fillCorner.Parent = fillBar
    
    local thumb = Instance.new("TextButton")
    thumb.Name = "Thumb"
    thumb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    thumb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    thumb.Position = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 0.5, 0)
    thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    thumb.Text = ""
    thumb.AutoButtonColor = false
    thumb.Parent = sliderBar
    
    local thumbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    thumbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    thumbCorner.Parent = thumb
    
    local isFolded = false
    foldBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isFolded = not isFolded
        if isFolded then
            foldBtn.Text = "+"
            sliderBar.Visible = false
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
        else
            foldBtn.Text = "-"
            sliderBar.Visible = true
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
        end
    end)

    local currentValue = defaultVal
    local sliding = false
    
    local function updateValue(inputPos)
        local barPos = sliderBar.AbsolutePosition.X
        local barSize = sliderBar.AbsoluteSize.X
        local relativeX = math.clamp(inputPos - barPos, 0, barSize)
        local percentage = relativeX / barSize
        currentValue = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * percentage)
        
        fillBar.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
        thumb.Position = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 0.5, 0)
        label.Text = labelText .. ": " .. tostring(currentValue)
    end
    
    thumb.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
        end
    end)
    
    sliderBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if sliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    
    return {
        GetValue = function() return currentValue end
    }
end

local autoFarmScroll = addCategory("Auto Farm")
local playerScroll = addCategory("Player")

local mainToggle  = createToggle(autoFarmScroll, "MainAttack", "Auto Roll")
local disabler5   = createToggle(autoFarmScroll, "Disable5", "Disable if 5+")
local disabler100 = createToggle(autoFarmScroll, "Disable100", "Disable if 100+")
local disabler250 = createToggle(autoFarmScroll, "Disable250", "Disable if 250+")
local disabler500 = createToggle(autoFarmScroll, "Disable500", "Disable if 500+")
local disabler1000 = createToggle(autoFarmScroll, "Disable1000", "Disable if 1000+")

local loopTpwalkToggle
local loopSpeedSlider
local selfFreezeToggle
local desyncToggle
local desyncSpeedSlider

local function startLoopTPWalk()
    if loopTpwalking then return end
    loopTpwalking = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while loopTpwalking and scriptRunning do
            local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
            if char and hum and hum.Parent and hum.Health > 0 then
                local speed = loopSpeedSlider.GetValue()
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    pcall(function()
                        char:TranslateBy(hum.MoveDirection * speed * delta * 10)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function startDesyncTPWalk()
    if desyncTpwalking then return end
    desyncTpwalking = true
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while desyncTpwalking and scriptRunning and char and hum and hum.Parent do
            local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            local speed = desyncSpeedSlider.GetValue()
            if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    char:TranslateBy(hum.MoveDirection * speed * delta * 10)
                end)
            end
            if not player.Character or player.Character ~= char then
                desyncTpwalking = false
                if desyncToggle then desyncToggle.SetState(false) end
            end
        end
    end)
end

loopTpwalkToggle = createToggle(playerScroll, "LoopTPWalk", "Loop TPWalk Speed", function(state)
    if state then
        startLoopTPWalk()
    else
        stopLoopTPWalk()
    end
end)

loopSpeedSlider = createSlider(playerScroll, "LoopSpeedSlider", "Loop TPWalk Speed", 1, 25, 4)

selfFreezeToggle = createToggle(playerScroll, "SelfFreeze", "Self Freeze")

desyncToggle = createToggle(playerScroll, "Desync", "Server-sided Desync", function(state)
    if state then
        startDesyncTPWalk()
    else
        stopDesyncTPWalk()
    end
end)

desyncSpeedSlider = createSlider(playerScroll, "DesyncSpeedSlider", "Desync Speed", 1, 25, 4)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    stopDesyncTPWalk()
    if desyncToggle then desyncToggle.SetState(false) end
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, 
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
            startPos.Y.Scale, 
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while scriptRunning do
        local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if (selfFreezeToggle.GetState() or desyncToggle.GetState()) and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            rootPart.Anchored = true
            if selfFreezeToggle.GetState() then
                humanoid.PlatformStand = true
            end
        else
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.Anchored = false
            end
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            end
        end
        
        task.wait(0.1)
        
        if mainToggle.GetState() then
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local val = currentAttackValue
                
                if disabler1000.GetState() and val >= 1000 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler500.GetState() and val >= 500 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler250.GetState() and val >= 250 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler100.GetState() and val >= 100 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler5.GetState() and val >= 5 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                end
                
                if mainToggle.GetState() then
                    pcall(function()
                        generateAttackEvent:FireServer("Random", nil, nil)
                    end)
                end
            else
                currentAttackValue = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)
